summary: psrp options for CredSSP (sub-auth mechanism, disabling TLS 1.2, minimum version 5 to avoid CVE-2018-0886), ignoring environment proxies, max WSMan envelope size (150 KiB), and message encryption modes.
questions: How do I protect psrp CredSSP against CVE-2018-0886?
How do I make psrp ignore my proxy environment variables?
What does message_encryption do for psrp over HTTP?
How do I increase the WSMan message size for psrp?
Which CredSSP sub-auth does psrp use by default?

answer_card.title: psrp CredSSP, proxy and encryption options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `credssp_auth_mechanism` (`auto` default, `kerberos`, `ntlm`): auto tries both, preferring Kerberos.
- `credssp_disable_tlsv1_2` (default false): only for hosts without TLS 1.2.
- `credssp_minimum_version` (default 2): set **5** to require hosts patched against CVE-2018-0886.
- `ignore_proxy` (default false): bypass environment proxy settings (ignored if `proxy` set).
- `max_envelope_size` (default 153600 bytes / 150 KiB).
- `message_encryption` (`auto` default, `always`, `never`): `auto` encrypts messages only when not using HTTPS; only negotiate, kerberos, ntlm and credssp can do message encryption; `never` disables encryption checks over HTTP.
